pages.text: Sneak-use the held flower on a container; plant within horizontal 3x3, vertical +/-1. Empty-hand use opens preview; use block faces to select. Redstone starts work; power off pauses and power on resumes. Sneak-use cycles single, line and level platform (last two need two points). Range +/-8 horizontal, +/-3 vertical. Each placed block costs 20 mana; existing blocks stay. Preview ends on completion.
